look.lighting: warm tungsten glow from the café window as the key, cool blue ambient from the street, wet reflections
look.style: cinematic film look, fine grain, soft halation
look.anchors: a small white ceramic cup with a thin gold rim, dark Egyptian coffee with a light foam

shots.subject: an old downtown Cairo café on a rainy night
shots.setting: a narrow street with Art Deco facades
shots.composition: café window on the right third, empty wet street leading to it
shots.motion: rain falls steadily and a passer-by with an umbrella slowly walks past the window
shots.camera_move: slow push in toward the window

shots.subject: the coffee cup on a marble table by the rainy window
shots.atmosphere: steam, raindrops run down the window glass behind the cup
shots.composition: cup centered, raindrops on the glass behind it out of focus
shots.motion: steam curls slowly upward while raindrops run down the window glass
